stories.title: AI found Linux kernel bugs that remained undetected for decades
stories.why: A Microsoft research project combining AI agents with human security researchers uncovered 59 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, including bugs that had survived in production code for more than 20 years.

stories.why: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 is reporting today that it has tracked a massive China-based attack leveraging the open-source AI penetration testing framework Cairn to autonomously conduct 25 operations against at least 19…

stories.title: November 2026 Patch Tuesday: 63 Critical Microsoft fixes, plus an Outlook zero day that allows theft of hashed credentials
stories.why: A currently exploited zero-day vulnerability that can let attackers steal hashed Outlook NTLM credentials is among the 1,094 holes Microsoft fixed in its November Patch Tuesday releases.

stories.title: Finite State Raises $27 Million to Help Device Makers Fight ‘Vulnpocalypse’ with AI-Powered Product Security

stories.title: Your pinned MCP server may not be as pinned as you think
stories.why: An MCP server configured to run one fixed release on an administrator’s workstation ran with 15 different sets of dependencies over five weeks, with its configuration untouched.

stories.title: OpenAI’s Daybreak brings AI agents to security testing and vulnerability fixes
stories.why: OpenAI is bringing AI agents into more of the software security process with Daybreak, pairing web application penetration testing with tools that investigate vulnerabilities and develop fixes.

stories.title: Japan Pushes Emergency Funding for Cybersecurity as AI-Assisted Breaches Rise
stories.why: The package adds public-private cyber responders, an AI-focused team run by the economic ministry, and more leeway to use the government's new active cyber-defense powers.

stories.title: SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI, Steals Data From 18 Agents and About 100 Users
stories.why: An attacker exploited a remote code execution flaw in SGLang, an open-source inference engine, and ran code on one of NEAR AI's inference servers last Sunday.

stories.title: AI Set to Revolutionize Ransomware Following “Stagnant” Few Years
stories.why: TrendAI’s Bob McArdle said ransomware techniques will change significantly in the next year, with AI making attacks more dangerous and profitable

stories.title: Security Teams Must Shift from Patching to Mitigation in the AI Era
stories.why: Symantec’s Dick O’Brien says the rapid closure of the patch window means organizations must move beyond patching and adopt an assume exploit mindset
